c5_tiny_overfit.evaluation_policy: Evaluate the frozen two-row fixture before training and only after the final model-only checkpoint is exported and reloaded. The fixed 150-step run intentionally avoids periodic full-model checkpoints/exports to control disk and I/O cost.

policy: Do not relax a threshold after seeing a failing result; record compatibility_blocked_at_C1, C4, or C5 instead. C5 is a same-fixture learnability gate, not a generalization or exact-resume claim.
